identified_problem: Česká spořitelna is the largest Czech retail bank, with a nationwide branch network and mortgage book. The September 2024 floods affected large parts of Moravia and northern Bohemia, damaging thousands of homes and businesses and putting collateral values at risk.
climate_exposure: Its Czech mortgage and SME portfolios are exposed to riverine and flash flooding along the Morava, Odra and Elbe basins and their tributaries.
potential_pain: Without hazard-linked collateral screening, the bank can be caught by correlated defaults in flood-affected regions and by post-disaster drops in real-estate collateral values.
evidence: Talaix flood exposure layers and historical event intelligence for the Morava, Odra and Elbe basins and affected Czech municipalities.
relevant_capability: Climate risk intelligence and flood exposure screening
recommended_message: Propose an API pilot screening a sample of Czech mortgage collateral locations against September 2024 flood footprints and current flood hazard layers.
fit_score: Strong fit: the largest Czech bank with a national mortgage footprint in regions directly affected by the September 2024 floods.

interactions.summary: Identified via official-source research; signal: Česká spořitelna homepage confirms it is a leading Czech retail bank with nationwide digital and branch reach.

next_action: Qualify: verify current public signal and select contact route
